name: Harmony 650, the test setup with chapter 7's screens
description: todo-compile-650 7.5. The 6.2.13 test setup with every screen chapter 7 builds: section 356's idle device list, activity menu and Off, the menu now in the setup file's order, and section 357's firmware screens, all built from a description. Against Logitech's clean compile the 5.2 comparison finds no difference but the menu's order. Predicted: the activity menu reads TV kijken and Film kijken on page 1, Muziek and Kodi kijken on page 2, and Plasma kijken alone on page 3, where 6.2.13's file had Logitech's order (Kodi kijken and Plasma kijken first). The infrared is 6.2.13's, unchanged: Plasma kijken sends the Plasma's power on (seven frames, its long press version) and the KPN box's power, then the Plasma's HDMI 1 about 6.5 s later; Radio sends KPN 1 once and KPN 2 about 2.2 s later; Muziek sends Kodi's and the Sony's power, the Plasma's power off and the Sony's Function three times, nothing to the KPN box; All Off sends Kodi's, the Sony's and the KPN box's power. New to look at: what the screen shows while All Off sends. As the configuration reads, section 357, it shows 'Turning system off' only once the welcome tour's mark is set, which the Remote Assistant's check sets at a restart; so 'Turning system off' is expected on both All Off presses, and if it does not appear that is the finding. The screen goes dark about 20 s after the last key. Keep the remote off the cable and pointed at the Flirc.

steps.instruction: Straight after the write the remote restarts and may show 'If any devices are still On press Help now'. Do NOT press Help. Take the remote off the cable, point it at the Flirc and press All Off once. Note whether the screen says 'Turning system off' while it sends. Mark when it is quiet

Press the centre key below the screen until the screen says Activities 1/3 at the top. Expect TV kijken at the top and Film kijken below it. Press the right arrow below the screen once: expect Activities 2/3 with Muziek at the top and Kodi kijken below it. Press it once more: expect Activities 3/3 with Plasma kijken alone at the top. Note any page that differs. Press the button beside Plasma kijken (upper left). Expect 'Starting Plasma kijken', the Plasma's power on and the KPN box's power, about 6.5 s later the Plasma's HDMI 1, then a screen titled Plasma kijken with Teletext, DVR, Aspect and Radio in its corners. If the remote restarts instead, note what the screen showed. Mark when it settles
Touch nothing and watch the screen: note roughly how many seconds after the last press it goes dark (about 20 expected). Then press any key once to wake it, and mark
Press the button beside Radio (lower right) once and touch nothing. Expect the KPN box's 1 and about 2 s later its 2. Mark when the 2 has been heard, or when 10 s have passed without it
Press the Listen to Music key (Muziek). Expect Kodi's and the Sony's power, the Sony's Function three times and the Plasma's power off, and nothing for the KPN box. Mark when it settles
Press All Off. Expect Kodi's, the Sony's and the KPN box's power, and 'Turning system off' on the screen while it sends. Note what the screen shows. Mark when it is quiet
